result.summary: Found a few visual issues, mainly a persistent loading indicator over a restaurant card and content appearing clipped/obscured near fixed areas of the layout.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image even though the restaurant card content and image are already visible. This makes the card look stuck in a loading state.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loader once the image/card has loaded, or only show it while the image area is genuinely empty/loading.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card is cut off by the fixed bottom navigation area, making the feed look like it continues underneath the nav bar without enough safe spacing.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content equal to the bottom navigation height plus safe-area inset so cards are not visually hidden behind it.

issues.description: Items in the horizontal carousels are partially clipped at the right edge, such as the category chip after Healthy and the third restaurant in Fastest near you. This may be intentional scrolling, but it looks abrupt in the screenshot.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal lists have consistent side padding and clear scroll behavior, or show partial items in a more deliberate way with proper spacing.
